summary: Enigma 1/2 is a BBS engine designed to run across multiple platforms with support for multiple simultaneous callers and legacy DOS door games. It provides a text-based communication and social interface reminiscent of classic bulletin board systems. The project is built using Node.js, Shell scripts, and Docker containers.
goodFor: This software suits hobbyists and retro computing enthusiasts looking to host a classic BBS with modern containerisation and legacy game compatibility.
watchOut: The maintenance velocity is slowing down and there are no official tagged releases, which may present stability risks for long-term production use. Furthermore, documentation and community support might be limited compared to mainstream communication platforms.
deployNotes: You can typically run this via Docker with persistent volumes configured for user data and door games, sitting behind a reverse proxy if you need TLS termination.
